title: "Docs in Motion"

![A stylized documentation dashboard with notes, cards, and workflow elements.](images/home-header.svg)

Welcome to a small Quarto-based documentation website built to showcase practical writing, publishing workflows, and clear information design.

This project is organized around three standalone documentation articles that focus on how teams create useful documents, maintain high-quality technical writing, and publish content in a way that is easy to find and easy to trust.

## Why documentation matters

Good documentation reduces confusion, shortens onboarding time, and helps teams move faster with fewer interruptions. It creates a shared source of truth for decisions, workflows, and product behavior. When written well, documentation becomes an asset instead of a chore.

## Featured articles

- [Planning documentation that people actually use](docs/articles/article-1.qmd)
- [Writing concise, readable technical content](docs/articles/article-2.qmd)
- [Publishing a static documentation site with Quarto](docs/articles/article-3.qmd)

## What this site demonstrates

- Clear article structure with headings and sections
- Markdown formatting for readability and accessibility
- Code examples and command snippets
- A lightweight publishing workflow using Quarto

This site is intentionally simple: it focuses on documentation quality over complexity. That is often the right balance for small projects, internal knowledge bases, and public-facing documentation sites.

> Documentation is not just a record of what happened; it is the system that helps the next person succeed.
